movelist.name: Knock Off
movelist.effect: Choose one of the target’s Held Items or Accessory Slot Items. It is knocked to the ground.

movelist.name: Detect
movelist.effect: If the user is hit by a Move, the user may use Detect. The user is instead not hit by the Move. You do not take any damage nor are you affected by any of the Move’s effects.

movelist.name: Rock Smash
movelist.effect: Rock Smash lowers the target’s Defense 1 Combat Stage on 17+.

movelist.name: Fury Cutter
movelist.effect: If Fury Cutter is used successfully and consecutively on the same target, the Damage Base is increased by +4 to a maximum of 16. For example, the first hit would have a DB of 4; the second hit a DB of 8; the third hit a DB of 12; the fourth and further hits a DB of 16. If Fury Cuter misses or fails to damage its target, its Damage Base resets.

movelist.name: Leer
movelist.effect: All legal targets have their Defense lowered by 1 Combat Stage.

abilities.name: Steadfast
abilities.effect: The user’s Speed is raised by +1 Combat Stage.

abilities.name: Super Luck
abilities.effect: The Pokémon’s Moves are Critical Hits on 18-20. If a Move already has an extended Critical Hit range, Super Luck extends that range by 2.
